newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, eyes possible cargo rise.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, eyes possible cargo rise.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were steady in quiet trade on Friday with sellers holding back offers on expectations of an increase in cargo prices.
Traders said the emergence of a local trader to buy a 20,000-tonne cargo on Thursday has spooked the market as some felt the trader might start to bid the physical market up.
Bunker enquiries picked up today with several big orders seen but no deals were fixed, one major said.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $100-$102 per tonne and 180-cst was at $107-$109. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $188-$192 and $200-205 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3093)
